title: The Baby Dragon's Secret Burden
style: cinematic live-action film still, 35mm, shallow depth of field, realistic skin, natural light, emotional mood, vertical 9:16

narrator.look: Riya, a kind young woman in her early 20s, with expressive brown eyes, long wavy hair in a loose braid, wearing a soft teal tunic and dark trousers. Her face shows deep empathy.

ignis.look: Ignis, a palm-sized baby dragon with glistening iridescent green scales, large, tearful golden eyes, tiny translucent wings, and delicate claws. It emits faint, wispy smoke.

scenes.image: Extreme close-up on Riya's intensely focused face, eyes wide, a single tear escaping, as if hearing something incredible and heartbreaking. Her hand is pressed to her ear.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Logon ko lagta main sab kuchh samjhti hoon.
scenes.sub: People think I understand everything.
scenes.say: लोगों को लगता मैं सब कुछ समझती हूँ।

scenes.image: Riya, younger, maybe 10-12 years old, kneeling beside a small, whimpering stray puppy on a park bench, gently stroking its head. Her face is sad but determined.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Bachpan se hi, main sun sakti thi unki awazein.
scenes.sub: Since childhood, I could hear their voices.
scenes.say: बचपन से ही, मैं सुन सकती थी उनकी आवाज़ें।

scenes.image: Riya, now as a young woman, holding a fussy baby, looking directly at the baby with a knowing, gentle smile. The baby looks calm.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Jo chhote the, bol nahi paate the apne dil ki.
scenes.sub: What the little ones couldn't say from their heart.
scenes.say: जो छोटे थे, बोल नहीं पाते थे अपने दिल की।

scenes.image: Riya in a uniform, smiling warmly, holding hands with a happy toddler in a bright, modern playroom.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Babies ho ya pets, main thi unki khaas nanny.
scenes.sub: Be it babies or pets, I was their special nanny.
scenes.say: बेबीज़ हो या पेट्स, मैं थी उनकी ख़ास नैनी।

scenes.image: Riya walking through a lush, green, slightly magical-looking forest path, dappled sunlight filtering through trees. She looks thoughtful.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Phir ek din, mili mujhe ek bahut special job.
scenes.sub: Then one day, I got a very special job.
scenes.say: फिर एक दिन, मिली मुझे एक बहुत स्पेशल जॉब।

scenes.image: An imposing, ancient-looking stone gate with intricate carvings, leading into a hidden sanctuary in a valley.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Himalay mein ek rahasyamayi Dragon Sanctuary mein.
scenes.sub: In a mysterious Dragon Sanctuary in the Himalayas.
scenes.say: हिमालय में एक रहस्यमयी ड्रैगन सैंक्चुअरी में।

scenes.image: Riya standing respectfully in front of a stern-looking man (Mr. Anand) in a uniform, who points towards a distant building.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Mr. Anand ne mujhe wahan bulaya tha, emergency mein.
scenes.sub: Mr. Anand had called me there, in an emergency.
scenes.say: मिस्टर आनंद ने मुझे वहाँ बुलाया था, इमरजेंसी में।

scenes.image: Close-up on a small, shimmering green dragon egg in an incubator, faint cracks visible, hinting at hatching.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Ek naya, bahut hi chhota baby dragon aaya tha.
scenes.sub: A new, very tiny baby dragon had arrived.
scenes.say: एक नया, बहुत ही छोटा बेबी ड्रैगन आया था।

scenes.image: Riya's face, filled with wonder and excitement, looking at Ignis for the first time as it hatches.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Maine use pehli baar dekha, aur bas dekhti reh gayi.
scenes.sub: I saw him for the first time, and just kept staring.
scenes.say: मैंने उसे पहली बार देखा, और बस देखती रह गई।

scenes.image: Ignis, just hatched, looking tiny and vulnerable, trying to stand, its eyes wide and golden.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Itna chhota, itna pyaara Ignis, mera dil khush ho gaya.
scenes.sub: So small, so cute Ignis, my heart was happy.
scenes.say: इतना छोटा, इतना प्यारा इग्निस, मेरा दिल खुश हो गया।

scenes.image: Ignis in a specialized incubator, its tiny head down, whimpering, tears visibly forming in its golden eyes.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Par woh nanha Ignis har waqt rota hi rehta tha.
scenes.sub: But that tiny Ignis kept crying all the time.
scenes.say: पर वो नन्हा इग्निस हर वक्त रोता ही रहता था।

scenes.image: Scientists and vets in lab coats examining Ignis's incubator with worried expressions. Riya stands nearby, looking concerned.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Doctors, scientists, sab baffled, koi samajh na paya.
scenes.sub: Doctors, scientists, all baffled, no one understood.
scenes.say: डॉक्टर्स, साइंटिस्ट्स, सब बैफल्ड, कोई समझ ना पाया।

scenes.image: Close-up on Ignis's tear-streaked face, its tiny mouth open in a silent scream of distress.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Koi nahi samjha ki woh itna dukhi kyun tha.
scenes.sub: No one understood why he was so sad.
scenes.say: कोई नहीं समझा कि वो इतना दुखी क्यों था।

scenes.image: Riya sitting by the incubator, her hand gently resting on the glass, looking at Ignis with deep sadness.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Main use chup karane ki koshish karti, par woh...
scenes.sub: I tried to soothe him, but he...
scenes.say: मैं उसे चुप कराने की कोशिश करती, पर वो...

scenes.image: Ignis, slightly larger now, but still crying, huddled in a small, soft bed, looking utterly miserable.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Woh rota hi rehta tha, din ho ya raat, bas rota.
scenes.sub: He kept crying, day or night, just crying.
scenes.say: वो रोता ही रहता था, दिन हो या रात, बस रोता।

scenes.image: Mr. Anand looking grim, pointing at some charts on a tablet, talking to other sanctuary staff. Riya watches anxiously.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Sanctuary ka future, Ignis ka jeevan, daav par the.
scenes.sub: The sanctuary's future, Ignis's life, were at stake.
scenes.say: सैंक्चुअरी का फ्यूचर, इग्निस का जीवन, दाँव पर थे।

scenes.image: A close-up of a 'Dragon Conservation Fund' sign with a crack in it, hinting at financial trouble and desperation.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Yeh nanha Ignis hi hamari aakhri ummeed, last hope.
scenes.sub: This tiny Ignis was our last hope, last hope.
scenes.say: ये नन्हा इग्निस ही हमारी आख़िरी उम्मीद, लास्ट होप।

scenes.image: Riya cradling Ignis gently, her eyes closed, concentrating intensely. Ignis still whimpering in her arms.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Maine use pyaar se apne kareeb rakha, hamesha.
scenes.sub: I kept him close to me with love, always.
scenes.say: मैंने उसे प्यार से अपने करीब रखा, हमेशा।

scenes.image: Extreme close-up on Riya's ear, a small, worried frown on her face as she listens intently.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Uski chupi awaz sunne ki koshish karti main.
scenes.sub: I tried to hear his hidden voice.
scenes.say: उसकी छुपी आवाज़ सुनने की कोशिश करती मैं।

scenes.image: Ignis clinging to Riya's shoulder, its small body trembling, tears streaming down its face.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Par uske dard bhare rone ki awaz ke siva kuchh na suna.
scenes.sub: But I heard nothing but the sound of his painful crying.
scenes.say: पर उसके दर्द भरे रोने की आवाज़ के सिवा कुछ ना सुना।

scenes.image: Riya looking exhausted but determined, sitting by Ignis's bed late at night, a dim lamp on.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Main haar nahi maan sakti thi, yeh pakka tha.
scenes.sub: I couldn't give up, that was for sure.
scenes.say: मैं हार नहीं मान सकती थी, ये पक्का था।

scenes.image: Close-up on Ignis's golden eyes, wide with fear, not just sadness. A subtle shift in expression.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Yeh sirf dard nahi tha, isme kuchh aur baat thi.
scenes.sub: This wasn't just pain, there was something else in it.
scenes.say: ये सिर्फ दर्द नहीं था, इसमें कुछ और बात थी।

scenes.image: Riya looking up from Ignis, her eyes widening as if a new, terrifying thought has struck her.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Kuchh aur hi tha jo use andar se dara raha tha.
scenes.sub: Something else was scaring him from within.
scenes.say: कुछ और ही था जो उसे अंदर से डरा रहा था।

scenes.image: Riya standing by a large map of the sanctuary, tracing a finger across it, deep in thought.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Maine sanctuary ka har kona dhyaan se dekha.
scenes.sub: I carefully checked every corner of the sanctuary.
scenes.say: मैंने सैंक्चुअरी का हर कोना ध्यान से देखा।

scenes.image: Riya checking temperature gauges, air filters, food samples in Ignis's room. All seem normal.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Sab kuchh perfectly fine laga, bilkul normal.
scenes.sub: Everything seemed perfectly fine, completely normal.
scenes.say: सब कुछ परफ़ेक्ट्ली फाइन लगा, बिल्कुल नॉर्मल।

scenes.image: Riya sitting outside Ignis's enclosure, looking defeated, her head in her hands.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Main uski wajah na dhoondh kar, paagal ho rahi thi.
scenes.sub: Not finding its reason, I was going crazy.
scenes.say: मैं उसकी वजह ना ढूँढ कर, पागल हो रही थी।

scenes.image: Riya looks up, suddenly resolute, and walks back to Ignis's enclosure with renewed determination.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Bas ek aakhri umeed, ek aakhri koshish bachi.
scenes.sub: Only a last hope, a last attempt remained.
scenes.say: बस एक आख़िरी उम्मीद, एक आख़िरी कोशिश बची।

scenes.image: Riya holds Ignis close to her chest, their eyes meeting. She closes her eyes, focusing intently. Ignis is still whimpering.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Maine Ignis ko dil se lagaaya, aankhon mein dekha.
scenes.sub: I held Ignis close to my heart, looked into his eyes.
scenes.say: मैंने इग्निस को दिल से लगाया, आँखों में देखा।

scenes.image: Close-up on Riya's face, eyes closed, a flicker of understanding dawning. A faint glow around her head.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Aur phir... ek bahut hi choti, dheemi awaz suni.
scenes.sub: And then... I heard a very tiny, faint voice.
scenes.say: और फिर... एक बहुत ही छोटी, धीमी आवाज़ सुनी।

scenes.image: Close-up on Ignis's face, its tears still flowing, but its expression is now one of desperate urgency. Its tiny mouth moves slightly.
scenes.speaker: ignis
scenes.line: Mitti mein... dushman chhupa hai! Khatra!
scenes.sub: In the earth... the enemy is hidden! Danger!
scenes.say: मिट्टी में... दुश्मन छुपा है! ख़तरा!

scenes.image: Riya's eyes snap open, shock and confusion on her face. She looks around frantically.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Mitti? Dushman? Yeh baby dragon kya bol raha tha?
scenes.sub: Earth? Enemy? What was this baby dragon saying?
scenes.say: मिट्टी? दुश्मन? ये बेबी ड्रैगन क्या बोल रहा था?

scenes.image: Riya looking down at Ignis, who is now nudging her hand towards the ground of its enclosure with its tiny head.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Usne apni choti claw se zameen ki taraf ishara kiya.
scenes.sub: He pointed with his tiny claw towards the ground.
scenes.say: उसने अपनी छोटी क्लॉ से ज़मीन की तरफ़ इशारा किया।

scenes.image: Close-up of Ignis's tiny claw scratching at the soft earth inside its enclosure, revealing darker soil beneath.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Zameen ke andar... kuchh bahut hi ajab sa tha.
scenes.sub: Inside the earth... something very strange was.
scenes.say: ज़मीन के अंदर... कुछ बहुत ही अजब सा था।

scenes.image: Riya looking intensely at the ground, a furrow in her brow, then scanning the surroundings. Everything seems normal.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Par bahar se to sab kuchh normal dikh raha tha.
scenes.sub: But from the outside, everything looked normal.
scenes.say: पर बाहर से तो सब कुछ नॉर्मल दिख रहा था।

scenes.image: Close-up on Ignis, now crying with renewed intensity, its body shaking, eyes wide with terror.
scenes.speaker: ignis
scenes.line: Zeher hai... sab khatam... ho jayega jaldi!
scenes.sub: It's poison... everything... will end soon!
scenes.say: ज़हर है... सब ख़त्म... हो जाएगा जल्दी!

scenes.image: Riya's face, horrified, understanding dawning, as she stands up abruptly, looking shocked.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Zeher? Yeh dragon itni badi baat kyun keh raha tha?
scenes.sub: Poison? Why was this dragon saying such a big thing?
scenes.say: ज़हर? ये ड्रैगन इतनी बड़ी बात क्यों कह रहा था?

scenes.image: Riya runs towards Mr. Anand's office, looking urgent and desperate, Ignis still in her arms.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Main Mr. Anand ke office ki taraf tezi se bhagi.
scenes.sub: I ran quickly towards Mr. Anand's office.
scenes.say: मैं मिस्टर आनंद के ऑफ़िस की तरफ़ तेज़ी से भागी।

scenes.image: Riya trying to explain animatedly to Mr. Anand, who looks skeptical but listens patiently, shaking his head.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Par woh meri baaton ko samjh nahi paaye the.
scenes.sub: But he couldn't understand my words.
scenes.say: पर वो मेरी बातों को समझ नहीं पाए थे।

scenes.image: Mr. Anand shakes his head gently, indicating there's no visible problem. Riya looks desperate, on the verge of tears.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Unko koi abnormal signs kahin dikh nahi rahe the.
scenes.sub: He couldn't see any abnormal signs anywhere.
scenes.say: उनको कोई एबनॉर्मल साइंस कहीं दिख नहीं रहे थे।

scenes.image: Close-up on Riya's tear-filled eyes, reflecting her frustration and Ignis's distress, a single tear rolls down her cheek.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Par Ignis ka rona sachha tha, main jaanti thi.
scenes.sub: But Ignis's crying was true, I knew it.
scenes.say: पर इग्निस का रोना सच्चा था, मैं जानती थी।

scenes.image: Riya returns to Ignis's enclosure, looks at the ground, then notices a subtle discolouration of a small patch of moss.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Usne phir mujhe usi jagah ki zameen dikhayi.
scenes.sub: He showed me the ground of that same spot again.
scenes.say: उसने फिर मुझे उसी जगह की ज़मीन दिखाई।

scenes.image: Close-up on the small patch of moss, now appearing slightly withered and discoloured, almost imperceptibly yellow.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Wahan ek chhota sa, peela, sookha hua spot dikha.
scenes.sub: There, a small, yellow, withered spot was visible.
scenes.say: वहाँ एक छोटा सा, पीला, सूखा हुआ स्पॉट दिखा।

scenes.image: Riya kneeling, touching the withered moss with a hesitant finger. Her face shows sudden realization, eyes widening.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Maine use chhua... aur ekdum se sab kuchh samjh gayi.
scenes.sub: I touched it... and suddenly understood everything.
scenes.say: मैंने उसे छुआ... और एकदम से सब कुछ समझ गई।

scenes.image: Flashback to Riya, as a child, touching a patch of dying grass, looking concerned, a sad expression on her face.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Mujhe apna bachpan yaad aaya, jab main sun sakti thi.
scenes.sub: I remembered my childhood, when I could hear.
scenes.say: मुझे अपना बचपन याद आया, जब मैं सुन सकती थी।

scenes.image: Flashback image of a drawing Riya made as a child: a plant wilting, with tiny crying faces drawn around it.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Kaise pehle bhi plants, dukh mein rote hue lagte the.
scenes.sub: How even plants seemed to cry in sorrow before.
scenes.say: कैसे पहले भी प्लांट्स, दुख में रोते हुए लगते थे।

scenes.image: Riya's face, now determined, looking directly at Ignis, who has stopped whimpering, watching her expectantly.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Ignis ne is hidden poison ko pehle hi detect kiya.
scenes.sub: Ignis had detected this hidden poison already.
scenes.say: इग्निस ने इस हिडन पॉइज़न को पहले ही डिटेक्ट किया।

scenes.image: Riya is frantically digging a small hole in the ground with a hand trowel, near the discoloured moss, her face urgent.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Zameen ke andar, kuchh bahut hi khaas chhupa tha.
scenes.sub: Inside the earth, something very special was hidden.
scenes.say: ज़मीन के अंदर, कुछ बहुत ही ख़ास छुपा था।

scenes.image: Close-up on Riya's hand pulling out a small, jagged rock that glows with a faint, unnatural green light.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Ek ajab sa, halka sa glowing patthar mila wahan.
scenes.sub: A strange, faintly glowing stone was found there.
scenes.say: एक अजब सा, हल्का सा ग्लोइंग पत्थर मिला वहाँ।

scenes.image: Ignis, no longer crying, but looking at the glowing stone with wide, terrified golden eyes.
scenes.speaker: ignis
scenes.line: Bahut bada khatra... bahut zyada khatra!
scenes.sub: Very big danger... too much danger!
scenes.say: बहुत बड़ा ख़तरा... बहुत ज़्यादा ख़तरा!

scenes.image: Riya, holding the glowing stone with a gloved hand, looking at it with horror, then glancing towards the distant mountains.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Yeh koi simple patthar nahi tha, kuchh aur tha.
scenes.sub: This was not a simple stone, it was something else.
scenes.say: ये कोई सिंपल पत्थर नहीं था, कुछ और था।

scenes.image: Close-up on Mr. Anand's shocked face as Riya shows him the glowing stone. His mouth is slightly open in disbelief.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Mr. Anand ne jab dekha toh woh bhi hairan ho gaye.
scenes.sub: When Mr. Anand saw it, he was also surprised.
scenes.say: मिस्टर आनंद ने जब देखा तो वो भी हैरान हो गए।

scenes.image: Scientists in hazmat suits carefully examining the stone in a lab, Riya and Mr. Anand watch from behind glass, looking worried.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Yeh ek bahut hi rare, zehreela toxic mineral nikla.
scenes.sub: This turned out to be a very rare, poisonous toxic mineral.
scenes.say: ये एक बहुत ही रेयर, ज़हरीला टॉक्सिक मिनरल निकला।

scenes.image: An aerial view of the sanctuary, with a red 'X' marking the spot where the stone was found, and arrows showing underground veins spreading.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Jo sanctuary ki zameen mein, dheere phail raha tha.
scenes.sub: Which was slowly spreading in the sanctuary's ground.
scenes.say: जो सैंक्चुअरी की ज़मीन में, धीरे फैल रहा था।

scenes.image: Riya looking at Ignis, who is now calm and sitting happily on her shoulder, no longer crying, looking alert.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Sirf Ignis hi us khatre ko pehchan paaya, feel kar paaya.
scenes.sub: Only Ignis could recognize that danger, could feel it.
scenes.say: सिर्फ़ इग्निस ही उस ख़तरे को पहचान पाया, फील कर पाया।

scenes.image: Ignis gently nuzzling Riya's cheek, a contented and relieved look on its face, its golden eyes peaceful.
scenes.speaker: ignis
scenes.line: Ab theek hai... sab theek hai, darr nahi.
scenes.sub: Now it's fine... everything is fine, no fear.
scenes.say: अब ठीक है... सब ठीक है, डर नहीं।

scenes.image: Riya smiling, relief washing over her face, as Ignis rests peacefully in her hands, looking up at her.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Us nanhe dragon ne hamari sabki jaan bachayi.
scenes.sub: That tiny dragon saved all our lives.
scenes.say: उस नन्हे ड्रैगन ने हमारी सबकी जान बचाई।

scenes.image: Sanctuary workers removing more glowing stones from the ground, wearing protective gear. The ground is being carefully excavated.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Sab log milkar is problem ko theek karne lage.
scenes.sub: Everyone started working together to fix this problem.
scenes.say: सब लोग मिलकर इस प्रॉब्लम को ठीक करने लगे।

scenes.image: A healthy, thriving Ignis, now a little bigger, flying short distances with confidence in a large, safe enclosure.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Ignis ab bilkul khush tha, bina darr ke ghoomta.
scenes.sub: Ignis was now completely happy, roaming without fear.
scenes.say: इग्निस अब बिल्कुल खुश था, बिना डर के घूमता।

scenes.image: Riya watching Ignis fly, a proud, loving smile on her face, her eyes full of affection.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Uska har aansoo, uska har rona, ek badi warning.
scenes.sub: His every tear, his every cry, was a big warning.
scenes.say: उसका हर आँसू, उसका हर रोना, एक बड़ी वॉर्निंग।

scenes.image: Riya kneeling, gently stroking Ignis as it lands on her arm. Their bond is clear, full of trust.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Meri special gift ne aaj sabhi ki jaan bacha li.
scenes.sub: My special gift saved everyone's lives today.
scenes.say: मेरी स्पेशल गिफ़्ट ने आज सभी की जान बचा ली।

scenes.image: Mr. Anand shaking Riya's hand warmly, a grateful and respectful smile on his face.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Mr. Anand ne dil se mujhse dhanyawad kiya.
scenes.sub: Mr. Anand thanked me from his heart.
scenes.say: मिस्टर आनंद ने दिल से मुझसे धन्यवाद किया।

scenes.image: A new, much larger sign for 'Himalayan Dragon Sanctuary' (without text, but implying grandeur), glowing softly, overlooking a peaceful valley.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Hamara pura sanctuary ab bahut safe aur protected tha.
scenes.sub: Our entire sanctuary was now very safe and protected.
scenes.say: हमारा पूरा सैंक्चुअरी अब बहुत सेफ़ और प्रोटेक्टेड था।

scenes.image: Riya and Ignis, a bit older, sitting peacefully by a waterfall in the sanctuary. Ignis is contentedly perched on Riya's shoulder.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Hum dono ka bond, Ignis aur mera, aur gehra hua.
scenes.sub: Our bond, Ignis's and mine, deepened further.
scenes.say: हम दोनों का बॉन्ड, इग्निस और मेरा, और गहरा हुआ।

scenes.image: Close-up on Ignis's calm, observant eyes, looking towards the horizon, no longer showing fear.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Ab woh bas dekhta, sunta, aur shaanti se baitha.
scenes.sub: Now he just watched, listened, and sat peacefully.
scenes.say: अब वो बस देखता, सुनता, और शांति से बैठा।

scenes.image: Riya's hand gently caressing Ignis's head, both looking peaceful and connected.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Chup rehkar bhi woh bahut sari baatein keh deta.
scenes.sub: Even in silence, he would say many things.
scenes.say: चुप रहकर भी वो बहुत सारी बातें कह देता।

scenes.image: Riya sitting with a group of happy children, showing them Ignis (safely in her arms). The children are awestruck and curious.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Main logon ko bhi sikhane lagi is chamatkar ke baare mein.
scenes.sub: I started teaching people about this miracle too.
scenes.say: मैं लोगों को भी सिखाने लगी इस चमत्कार के बारे में।

scenes.image: Riya pointing to her ear, then to the children's hearts, encouraging them to listen with empathy.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Dil se suno un chhote-chhote jeevon ki awaaz ko.
scenes.sub: Listen with your heart to the voices of those tiny beings.
scenes.say: दिल से सुनो उन छोटे-छोटे जीवों की आवाज़ को।

scenes.image: Close-up of Riya's hand holding Ignis's tiny claw, a symbol of trust, understanding, and connection.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Jo apni baatein kabhi bhi bol nahi paate humse.
scenes.sub: Who can never speak their thoughts to us.
scenes.say: जो अपनी बातें कभी भी बोल नहीं पाते हमसे।

scenes.image: Riya looking directly at the camera with a gentle, knowing smile, Ignis perched calmly on her shoulder.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Unke andar chhupe secrets bahut zyada gehre hain.
scenes.sub: The secrets hidden inside them are very deep.
scenes.say: उनके अंदर छुपे सीक्रेट्स बहुत ज़्यादा गहरे हैं।

scenes.image: A stunning wide shot of the Himalayan Dragon Sanctuary at sunset, with a faint, magical glow emanating from the central building. Riya and Ignis are tiny figures watching the sunset.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Aapko kya lagta hai, animals aur babies kya chhupate hain?
scenes.sub: What do you think, what do animals and babies hide?
scenes.say: आपको क्या लगता है, एनिमल्स और बेबीज़ क्या छुपाते हैं?

caption: This Nanny Heard A Baby Dragon's Secret Plea 🐉 (Emotional Story)
yt_title: This Nanny Heard A Baby Dragon's Secret Plea 🐉 (Emotional Story)
description:
Everyone thought the baby dragon was just sick, but this nanny heard a deeper cry. She had a gift no one else possessed. Could she uncover the truth before it was too late?
What hidden messages do you think animals try to tell us?
